text:
Asha (CS): quick check — Sienna preview cohort 2: are we on track for next-week go-live? any enrollment or health flags I should surface to the execs?
Miguel (CS Ops): on track. 8 seats accepted, 2 on the waiting list. SSO handshake is the main blocker, scheduled for Wed. data ingress + sample dataset looks fine.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): pushed the onboarding script that handles larger context windows. asked Sienna for their test corpus yesterday, still pending. will add a fallback for very long prompts.
Cindy (Onboarding): onboarding plan drafted: Wed 10am PT SSO session, Thu 2pm sandbox walkthrough + runbook. need final access list from Sienna (emails + who needs admin). @Sam (Product) can you confirm the list of personas we should invite?
Sam (Product): will ping them now. also request from product: let's capture a latency trace for the `generate_summary` route during preview and include that in the feedback packet. can someone add an eval prompt set?
Asha (CS): :thumbsup: good call. add a small eval set focused on multi-doc summarization to the beta feedback doc. note: account health score slipped from 85 -> 70 on the renewal PQ because of privacy/residency concerns — flagging that to legal/product.
Miguel (CS Ops): privacy flagged. infra has a KMS/private-deploy option we can offer. can propose a 30-day private trial if they sign NDA.
Jordan (Solutions Eng): if SSO hangs, we can temp-fallback to scoped API keys and a shortened onboarding checklist. i'll draft a quick how-to snippet to paste into the runbook.
BetaBot: new_signup: sienna+seat9@example.com accepted (seat 9) :tada:
Cindy (Onboarding): we should run a 15-minute office hours immediately after onboarding for quick troubleshooting. @Asha do you want to lead that?
Asha (CS): I can lead office hours. cadence proposal: daily async notes first 3 days, weekly summaries for the rest of preview. also want to capture feature requests ASAP so we can triage regressions. @Jordan can you add a feedback doc template?
Jordan (Solutions Eng): done — https://docs.google.com/document/d/preview-sienna-feedback (internal link). added sections: setup blockers, latency, accuracy notes, regression blocker checkbox.
Sam (Product): will wire an alert to the eval dashboard for any regression-blocking quality drop. also want to collect a small set of user prompts to run through Redwood Optimize recommendations.
Miguel (CS Ops): timeline summary: SSO Wed, sandbox Thu, synthetic load + trace Fri. if green -> soft go-live Mon. i'll post load test results to this thread.
Asha (CS): any outstanding legal / NDA issues?
Cindy (Onboarding): Sienna legal asked about EU data residency clause in the DPA.
Miguel (CS Ops): looping in @Hannah (Legal) to advise on residency clause and whether we need region-only keys.
Hannah (Legal): we can provision EU-region-only keys and a region-restricted onboarding flow, but need signed DPA + data processing addendum. i'll draft a DPA addendum and share by EOD.
Asha (CS): perfect — thanks everyone. deploy checklist looks solid. please post any blockers here rather than DMs so execs can get a quick pulse.
BetaBot: reminder: onboarding session scheduled Wed 10:00 PT (Sienna cohort 2) — attendees: 10 (including 2 observers).
